name: m-
description: Mdash is a design system built with modern web standards. It's impossibly small (just 6kb), extremely fast, simple, and compatible with any web project.

scripts.watch: nodemon --watch src --ext css --exec npm run build
scripts.build: rm -r dist; mkdir dist && npm run css && npm run icons && cp -R dist/** docs
scripts.release: npm run build && git pull && git commit -a -m "Released new version: $VERSION" && git push --tags origin master
